name: jm-games
description: Game and graphics skills: GDD and staged browser-game delivery (mini-GDD, MVP, final), three.js, react-three-fiber, Phaser, audio, Blender and web QA tools, version-specific three.js facts, and a reference-driven art iteration loop.

interface.shortDescription: Game design, staged browser-game builds, engine tools, and art iteration
interface.longDescription: gdd writes a game design document and the build's agent files. mini-gdd, mvp and final take a browser game from prompt to finished build under the delivery contract; feather-prep packages a Feather submission. The tools-* skills cover three.js (scene, materials, glTF, gameplay, look, procedural meshes, UI, debugging), react-three-fiber, pmndrs postprocessing, Phaser 4, Web Audio, Blender models and web QA. threejs holds version-specific three.js and react-three-fiber facts that models get wrong from training data. art-iteration iterates a visual deliverable against reference images until an image-only critic passes it.
defaultPrompt: Use the threejs skill to check this WebGPU code.
Iterate this effect against the reference until the critic passes it.
